people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: “In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
translations.bsb: In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous Branch, and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
translations.kjv: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
translations.asv: In those days, and at that time, will I cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.
